[.claude/templates/diagram-style-guide.md#fill-approach--light-tinted-fills-with-thin-solid-strokes]

## Fill Approach — Light Tinted Fills with Thin Solid Strokes

**Default approach:** Very light tinted fills (~5-8% opacity equivalent) with thin saturated strokes (1px) and dark text. This produces a clean, modern, airy look. Structural anchors (header, footer, guardrails bar) use saturated gradient fills for visual weight.

**Rule:**

- **Stroke**: use the saturated brand color at 1px weight (not 2px)
- **Fill**: use the barely-tinted version of the same color (~5-8% white-mixed)
- **Text**: dark (`#2b3a44`) on tinted fills — always readable

**When to use saturated/gradient fills instead:**

- Header bar (gradient: `#2435C7` → `#00B9D8`)
- Header accent line (`#00C49A`, 4px)
- Footer/guardrails bar (gradient: `#17207A` → `#00708A`)
- Accent stripes on card panels (6px vertical, saturated color)
- Icon badge backgrounds (saturated fill inside circle outlines)

## Brand Colors — Three-Color Gradient System

The palette flows from deep blue through cyan to green, creating a natural progression that can encode phases, maturity levels, or emphasis.

page_texts.13: [.claude/templates/diagram-style-guide.md#font-contrast-rules] ## Font Contrast Rules **CRITICAL — the #1 quality gate.** White text (`#FFFFFF`) is ONLY allowed on cells that have a dark or saturated `fillColor` (gradient header, dark bars, saturated badges, cloud shapes). If a cell has a light/tinted fill (`#f0f2fd`, `#eaf8fc`, `#ecfaf4`, `#f5fafd`, `#fafdff`, `#f9fafb`, `#f4f6f9`, `#f0faf7`, etc.) or no fill at all, the text MUST be dark charcoal (`#2b3a44`) for both body and bold titles. Before generating any `fontColor=#FFFFFF`, verify the cell's `fillColor` is in the dark/saturated set below. When in doubt, use dark text — it's always readable. **Dark fills where white text is correct:** `#2435C7`, `#00B9D8`, `#00C49A`, `#17207A`, `#00708A`, `#2b3a44`, `#1a2ba8`, `#028a70`, `#016b58`, `#e67e22`, `#c0392b`, `#7d3c98`, `#8c5ced`, `#2874a6`, `#019681`, `#2e307a`, `#1931e3`, `#55206e`, `#cc1ac7`. | Background | Text | Result | | --- | --- | --- | | Gradient header → White text | `#FFFFFF` | **Required** on header/footer gradients | | Dark bar → Bright green text | `#00E4A9` | **Required** for guardrails titles | | Dark bar → Ice blue text | `#d3e5fa` | **Required** for guardrails body text | | Tinted fill → Dark text | `#2b3a44` | **Required** for all tinted fills | | Saturated fill → White text | `#FFFFFF` | **Required** for icon badge fills | | Light on light | | **Never** | | Dark on dark | | **Never** |

[.claude/templates/diagram-style-guide.md#card-panel-design]

## Card Panel Design

Side panels (domain labels, category cards) use this pattern:

- **Background:** `#f5fafd` with `#c2c6d2` 1px border
- **Accent stripe:** 6px vertical bar on the left edge, saturated color matching the domain
- **Icon:** white circle (`#FFFFFF`) with colored 2px stroke, saturated icon shape inside
- **Title:** 18pt bold, color matches the accent stripe
- **Subtitle:** 11pt `#5a6978`
- **Divider:** 1px `#c2c6d2` horizontal line
- **Tags:** 11pt `#5a6978`

## Chevron Progression (for maturity/phase diagrams)

When showing phases, stages, or maturity levels:

| Element | Style |
| --- | --- |
| Chevron shapes | `shape=step;perimeter=stepPerimeter;size=24;strokeColor=#FFFFFF;strokeWidth=3` — use gradient trio colors left to right |
| Step numbers | White circle with colored stroke and number, 34px diameter, 16pt bold, centered on chevron |
| Labels | Separate text cells with `labelBackgroundColor=#FFFFFF`, dark font color matching the chevron |
| Flow line | 4px gradient bar (`#2435C7` → `#00C49A`) below chevrons |
